findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

The hand sink by the drive thru and the hand sink by the three part sink were observed with gaps forming around the edges. The PIC was shown and instructed to re-seal the locations prior to the next routine inspection. Ensure that all surfaces in the food preparation and cleaning areas are maintained in a smooth and easily cleanable state to facilitate effective cleaning.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.citation_text:
2-301.12(B) Cleaning Procedure. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use the following cleaning procedure in the order stated to clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms, including surrogate prosthetic devices for hands and arms: ... (5) Immediately follow the cleaning procedure with thorough drying using a method as specified under § 6-301.12.

Employees are observed to wash hands and then use their bare hands to turn off the faucet during this inspection. Education was conducted with the PIC and they are instructed to trickle down the needed information. They should also be monitoring the hand washing practices in the facility to ensure that they are being conducted correctly at all times. Ensure proper hand washing takes place at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.citation_text:
2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD.

1) Employees are observed to not wash hands prior to donning gloves. 2) Employees are observed to change tasks without hand washing or changing gloves. Education was conducted with the PIC and they are instructed to re-educate employees about glove changing and hand washing practices. They should also be aware of ongoing practices and enforce safe practices. Ensure hand washing is taking place WHEN it should be in the facility.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(B) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations.

A tray used for hot holding cooked chicken prior to service is observed with encrusted grease deposits and in use. The inspector scraped their fingernail on the item to ensure that it was encrusted grease and not a stain. The PIC was shown and instructed to scrub the trays in order to provide a smooth and easily cleanable (as well as clean) surface for food contact moving forward. Ensure that all food contact surfaces are maintained free of encrusted grease and other contaminants in the facility at all times.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. 

The space above the fries/tater tots hot holding station is heavily soiled with food debris and oil. The PIC was shown and instructed to clean and maintain clean moving forward. Ensure that all physical facilities are maintained clean at all times.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.12: (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. 

Multiple food handlers are observed to wash their hands and then use their bare hands to turn off the faucet. Education was conducted with the PIC and they are instructed to re-educate employees as to proper hand washing procedures.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. 

On arrival two of the hand sinks around the food preparation areas are without a hand drying device. Paper towels were supplied to correct. Ensure that hand sinks are maintained effectively supplied at all times.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment:
3-304.14: (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily. 

Multiple wiping cloths are observed on counters throughout the facility. Education was conducted and the cloths moved to their buckets to correct. Ensure that all wiping cloths are stored between uses in solution of sufficient concentration to maintain them sanitized.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria.

The sani buckets at the front of the facility are observed not showing on inspector test strips. The buckets were remade to correct the violation.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

The nozzles of the fountain drink machines are heavily soiled and in need of cleaning. The PIC was shown one as an example and instructed to clean them all. They were cleaned during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. 

Multiple tongs hanging above the three part sink are observed with grease and food debris still on them. Ensure that all food contact items are cleaned thoroughly prior to storage. The tongs were moved back to the “dirty” pile for re-cleaning to correct.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment:
3-304.14: (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily. (C) Cloths in-use for wiping raw animal FOOD surfaces shall be separate from other cloths. (D) Dry wiping cloths and sanitizing solution shall be free of FOOD debris and other soil. 

A moist wiping cloth is observed on a counter to the right of the fryer station. Ensure that all wiping cloths are stored between uses in solution. The rag was placed back in solution to correct.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing. [C]

Food debris observed throughout the facility behind equipment at floor/wall junction. Areas of specific note include behind the fryers, on top of the fry hot holding unit and under the shelves in the walk in cooler. Clean routinely to prevent accumulation and reduce the chances of pests.

findings.comment:

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Water observed pooling under the racks near the dry storage/desk area. Floor appears to slope away from the drain located near the desk. Make necessary adjustments/repairs to prevent water from ponding.
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. [C]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: Quaternary ammonium sanitizer measured 100 ppm in sanitizer bucket. Maintain concentration as indicated on manufacturer's label. CORRECTED- Sanitizer was remade to a concentration of 200ppm.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114 (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling. (P)

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.comment:
Observed an employee have gloves on and touch his pants. The employee was instructed to wash hands after each time.
750-530e Employees shall maintain a high degree of personal cleanliness and shall conform to good hygienic practices during all working periods in the food service establishment.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed food being stored on the floor of the walk-in freezer. Ensure that food is stored at least 6 inches off the floor. Manager moved the product during the inspection. 
750-130(b) Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Observed multiple single service articles to be soiled, or stored in a soiled container. Ensure that single service articles are not stored in a manner that allows them to be contaminated. Store them in an area, food contact surface down, where they will not receive food splash. Manager discarded soiled single service during the inspection. 
750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed the faucet in the female restroom to have a leak around the hot water handle. Ensure that this is repaired by an IL licensed plumber so it does not leak from around this handle. 
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed what appeared to be mold on the soda nozzles of the soda machine by the drive up window. Wash, rinse, and sanitize food contact surfaces.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
The following non food contact surfaces were soiled: 1) shelves in the walk in cooler with food debris 2) bottom portion of the prep cooler on the cook line with food debris 3) shelves in the slushy/ice cream prep cooler with food debris. Clean all non food contact surfaces.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Observed coffee filters stored on a shelf at the drive up window. Store coffee filters in a covered container.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
1) The floor in the walk in freezer was soiled with food debris. Clean floor. 2) The mop sink drain was soiled with large debris. Clean drain. 3) Floor underneath the soda boxes were soiled with debris. Clean floor.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
The hand sink by the three compartment sink was separating from the wall. Reseal sink to the wall.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.citation_text:
750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.
Provide a thermometer in this unit.

Repair this equipment.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed that thelid of the prep freezer containg beef patties next to the grille, had the lid left open between uses. Also observed bags of candy toppings in the storage area, and boxes of meat products in the walk in cooler that were open and not reclosed between uses.      
750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.
Close lids and containers during storage.

findings.title: Foods handled with minimal manual contact
findings.comment:
Observed the employee making sandwiches had direct hand contact with the buns during sandwich assembly.  
750-280 Food handlers & consumers shall avoid direct hand contact with ready to eat foods.  When handling ready to eat foods use suitable utensils (gloves, tongs, scoop, deli tissue, etc.)
Use proper barrier methods when handling ready-to-eat foods.
CORRECTED= employee

findings.title: Proper hygienic practices, eating/drinking/smoking (evidence)
findings.comment:
Observed employee drink located adjacent to breading machine; and the cup did not have a lid or straw. 
750-530a Employees shall consume food only in designated dining areas. An employee dining area shall not be so designated if consuming food there may result in contamination of other food, equipment, utensils, or other items needing protection.
Consume food only in designated areas, and only use drinking containers that have a lid and straw.
CORRECTED= Drink container was moved to employee break area.

Dumpster lid open upon arriving at inspection. Keep lid closed when not in use.
750-1130a Garbage and refuse shall be kept in durable easily cleanable, insect-proof, and rodent-proof containers.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.comment: 750-820d Equipment and utensils shall be sanitized in the third compartment according to one of the methods included in section 750.820 (e) (1) through (4). Sanitizer concentration for the machine that serves the 3 part sink is found to be at 100ppm quat. The minimum concentration should be 200ppm quat. The machine will be fixed but until that time the sanitizer from the front sink will be hauled to the back sink when the sink needs to be used.  All sanitation buckets will also be filled from this sanitizer dispensing station. The manager fixed the machine while I wrote this report and it is now dispensing sanitizer in the proper concentration.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use or any time they may have become contaminated.  The ice machine drop guard and back wall are soiled along with the cutting boards.  Wash, rinse and sanitize the above mentioned items.  If cutting boards are too scored to be cleaned effectively they may need to be replaced.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris. There are some areas that have dust accumulation: 1) top of ice machine 2) rack next to ice machine 3) fryer above filter system. Clean and keep clean.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: 750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents. The seal behind the back 3 part sink is soiled and starting to come out. Clean and Repair/replace seal. Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings. The back of the 3 part sink was cleaned and sealed while I wrote this report.
